method: Read displayed rules and public game manifest. Played using native browser keyboard, mouse/tap, and a native CDP touch hold/release. Read visible HUD and inspected screenshots. No arcade implementation source, solver paths, response probes, state injection or hidden runtime variables were inspected.

sample.ordinaryActions: Aimed right briefly and took a first shot at default 60% power, then waited for rest.
sample.observed: One stroke recorded; ball hit the central obstacle and stopped below it. Aim line and BALL IN MOTION/AIM THEN SHOOT feedback made next action understandable. No instant win.
sample.assessment: Bank-shot/friction puzzle was readable. Did not finish all three greens.

sample.ordinaryActions: Tilted right briefly, held thrust, then coasted.
sample.observed: Fuel fell to 96%; tilt 21 degrees and horizontal speed 34 were visible. Changing thrust affected descent.
sample.assessment: Meaningful inertial control and useful telemetry. Degrees/radians instruction mismatch was found and fixed; no full landing completed in this review.

sample.ordinaryActions: Identified striped pest in visible square 7, resumed and pressed 7.
sample.observed: Earned 100 points and 1/12 pests without losing care. Pest artwork is visibly distinct from empty holes; row numbers help keyboard selection.
sample.assessment: Selective reaction mechanic and mobile composition were clear. Full 30 second shift not completed.

sample.ordinaryActions: Initially tried Space after button resume; after diagnosing focus issue, used a timed Jump button press from visual countdown.
sample.observed: Earned 100 points and 1/16 clean skips with all 3 catches remaining. Premature untutored presses did not instantly award progress.
sample.assessment: Countdown/rope cue teaches timing; focused resume regression now jumps correctly.

sample.ordinaryActions: Held left flipper while launching, then alternated right hold after the ball rose.
sample.observed: Three bumper contacts earned 300 points;3 balls remained. Flippers, gutter and drain were visually clear.
sample.assessment: Different physical objective from the original Afterglow volley game; full 1000 point target not completed.

sample.ordinaryActions: Used visible fish direction/depth to hold the on-screen Cast control for about 1.5 seconds using native touch, then released.
sample.observed: Landed 1 fish on 1 cast, earned 321 points; hooked fish automatically reeled aboard as instructions promised.
sample.assessment: Touch behavior and staged cast/reel feedback felt coherent. Full 3 fish round not completed.

findings.reproduction: Rope Skip: Start, click/tap Pause, click/tap Resume, then press documented Space action.
findings.before: Focus remained on pause button; Space activated that button and paused again instead of jumping.
findings.status: fixed by owner and independently verified
findings.after: Fresh 320 px reload: focus CANVAS#game after Resume; Space left button label Pause and screenshot showed IN THE AIR.

findings.reproduction: Read Soft Landing rule 3 beside its live tilt HUD.
findings.before: Rules required 0.22 radians while HUD displayed degrees.
findings.status: fixed by owner and independently verified
findings.after: Fresh page now says within about 13 degrees of upright.

visualReview.desktop: Inspected paused desktop layouts for golf, lander and garden, and active desktop Rope Skip screenshot.
visualReview.mobile: Inspected active 390 px garden, golf, lander, harbor, pinball and rope screenshots; inspected fixed 320 px Rope Skip screen. No clipped controls or horizontal overflow observed in inspected views.

distinctness.observedSample: Six sampled games use bank shots, velocity-controlled landing, selective pest tapping, periodic jumping, flipper rebounds and hook-depth interception. These are meaningfully different decision loops.
distinctness.metadataOnlyForRemaining: The other nine Arcade Room games were reviewed by stated mechanics only, not ordinary-play sessions.
overlapNotes: Paper Links, Quiet Curl, Moon Basket and Table Bowls share aim/power controls, but declared objectives and physics differ: course navigation, proximity scoring, ballistic hoop entry and multi-ball pocketing. Only Paper Links was played in this audit.

Rope Skip and Beat Post share timing with original Pocket Orbit/Sky Stack, but periodic character clearance and multi-lane note delivery differ from stopping a marker or stacking slabs. Beat Post was not played.
Pinball Pocket shares ball rebounds with Afterglow, but flipper/gutter survival differs from a planned volley. No exact reskin identified in sampled play.
Original memory, sliding puzzle, lantern toggling, crate pushing, color flooding and anagrams do not duplicate sampled Arcade mechanics.

recommendation: No remaining blocking ordinary-play issue found in the six-game sample after the two fixes. This is a sampled usability/mechanics audit, not an assertion that all 100 games were manually played or that every Arcade round was completed.
limits: Six of 15 Arcade games received ordinary-play attempts; remaining nine were metadata review only.
Most attempts tested learning and early progression, not entire rounds. Existing solver coverage is separate evidence.
Desktop/mobile emulation used Chromium; no physical phone, other browser engine, screen reader or multi-person usability study.
Brief pause was used while inspecting some captured screens. Timing success after inspection is not evidence of untouched real-time difficulty.
